# Requirements traceability

## Directives

From [Digital product development](digital-product-development.md):

- Name the user and the task of each feature before you design or build the feature. ^name-user-and-task

From [Software engineering](software-engineering.md):

- Do not commit a secret to a repository. ^no-secret-in-repository
- If a secret reaches a repository, revoke the secret. ^revoke-exposed-secret
- Write a test for each change in behavior. ^test-each-behavior-change

## Definition

The record of the link between each requirement and each test that verifies it. A traceability matrix lists each requirement next to the tests that cover it. A requirement with no test is not yet verified, and a test with no requirement has no reason to exist.
